title: Transitivity triangle for ring cotangent complexes
statement: Let $A\to P\to B$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings. With the standard cotangent complexes of [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence], there is a canonical distinguished triangle $L_{P/A}\otimes_P^{\mathbf L}B\to L_{B/A}\to L_{B/P}\to(L_{P/A}\otimes_P^{\mathbf L}B)[1]$ in $D(B)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The first two arrows are the standard functoriality arrows for the ring maps. The triangle is natural under commutative diagrams of triples of ring maps.
